title: Design: Vendor invoice due date for a shop's Net term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A vendor on the shop's own term due 10 days after the invoice date has a bill dated Oct 5, 2026.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 10 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-43 Ten.
  • {Vendor-A} is on {Term-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-43 Vendor.
  • {Vendor-A} has a saved vendor invoice, {Vendor-invoice-A}, dated Oct 5, 2026.
    For example: {Vendor-invoice-A} is a vendor invoice for one part.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p7-11-vendor-on-net-10-oct-5-due-oct-15.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the vendor invoices list (Parts, Vendors, Vendor Invoices).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Vendor-invoice-A}.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Vendor Invoice card shows "Invoice date" Oct 5, 2026 and "Due date" Oct 15, 2026 (as in ct-p7-11-vendor-on-net-10-oct-5-due-oct-15.png).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R1: “A Net term (standard or the shop's own) is due that many days after the invoice date: an invoice dated Oct 5 on Net 30 is due Nov 4; on a shop's "Net 10" it is due Oct 15.”
  • S7-R9: “A vendor invoice stores no term. Its due date is calculated by the same rules from the vendor's term when the vendor invoice is created, recalculated when its invoice date or its vendor changes, and stored.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
